## Load Packages

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
minute_comparison_original <- read_csv(here("Emergency_Response", "block_data_pop.csv"))

colnames(minute_comparison_original)
```

## Prep Data

Reminder: $Delta = Flood - Baseline$

positive Delta = Baseline is faster negative Delta = Detour (no bridge) is faster

```{r}
# round delta time value to the nearest whole number
min_comp <- minute_comparison_original |>
  filter(metric == "Travel time (minutes)") |>
  mutate(baseline_time = round(baseline_value, digits = 0),
         flood_time = round(alternative_value, digits = 0),
         delta_round = round(delta, digits = 0)) |>
  group_by(block_geoid_2020) |>
  slice_min(alternative_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() |>
  filter(delta >= 0)

range(min_comp$delta_round, na.rm = T)
unique(min_comp$delta_round, na.rm = T)
         
```

## Parameter: Relative Risk Values

11/14/26 AD: RR values calculated from AORs in Waalwijk et al. (2022) (<https://doi.org/10.1097/TA.0000000000003380>)

```{r}
rr <- read_csv(here("Emergency_Response", "relative_risk.csv")) |>
  mutate(delta_round = response_time_min)

min_comp_rr <- inner_join(min_comp, rr, by = "delta_round")
```

## Parameter: Mortality Rates per County

```{r}
sd_mort <- 35/100000 #REPLACE WITH REAL VALUE!!!!!
riv_mort <- 33/100000 #REPLACE WITH REAL VALUE!!!!!
```

## Calculation: Per Census Block

```{r}
# calculate the additional mortalities (count) per census block based on delay time

mort_calc <- min_comp_rr |>
  mutate(base_mort = population_2020*(ifelse(county == "San Diego County", sd_mort, riv_mort)),
         flood_mort = population_2020*(ifelse(county == "San Diego County", sd_mort, riv_mort))*relative_risk,
         add_mort = flood_mort - base_mort)
```

## Calculation: Total Study Area

```{r}
# add up all values of additional mortalities (count)
total_add_mort <- sum(mort_calc$add_mort)
print(total_add_mort)
```

## Calculation: Final Cost

VSL: \$12,594,964.20 (Source: <https://www.bls.gov/data/inflation_calculator.htm>, 7.4 mil in 2006 Dollars)

```{r}
total_cost_mort <- total_add_mort*(1.68/365.25)*(12594964.20) 

print(total_cost_mort)
```
